Local source snapshots used by gromox-core/Dockerfile.

The directories in this folder are copied into the Docker build context from
the working trees on the development machine. They intentionally do not
contain .git directories or node_modules.

gromox: local working tree, branch arvera-shared-only-mapi (gromox.tar.gz)
grommunio-web: local working tree, branch arvera-operator-users
admin-api: local working tree, branch arvera-operator-users
admin-web: local working tree, branch arvera-operator-users
